report.title: Report
report.description: Builds a Word (docx) report from module results; stale results are not included.
report.project.name: Project name
report.check.name: Check
report.assumption.wall.surcharge_incline: Surcharge given per inclined surface area; q / cos β on the horizontal projection (q = {q} kPa, β = {beta}°)
report.assumption.wall.ls_extreme_i: The Extreme Event I live-load (LS) factor is taken as 0.50: this is not an AASHTO table value but a project-specific γEQ assumption; replace it with the project's actual value
report.assumption.wall.default_approach: No design approach was selected; the first approach {approach} of the code was used.
report.liq.lpi_incomplete: LPI is incomplete (some points are invalid and count as 0; the index may be understated)
report.page.subtitle: Builds a Word (docx) report from stored results. Stale or result-less sections are not included.
report.page.empty: There is nothing to report yet. Run a calculation first.
report.page.refused.no_result: Some sections have no result; run the calculation first:
report.page.refused.stale_result: Some sections have stale results; recalculate:
report.assumption.wall.shear_key_passive: Shear key ({position}, b = {width} m, d = {depth} m): passive resistance on the front face with Rankine K_p; vertical stress starts at the front ground (front fill + foundation γ); reduction factor {reduction} (same as FS_p = 2 in the METU CE366 example); reduced by (1−k_v)K_PE/K_P in the seismic case. Key passive counts regardless of the toe-passive setting; if the front soil may be removed by excavation or scour, enter embedment D = 0
report.assumption.wall.shear_key_surface: Sliding is checked on two surfaces: the base interface (V tanδ_b + c_a·B′ + key passive) and the horizontal plane through the key tip ((ΣV + soil weight beside the key) tanφ + c·B′ + key passive). On the key-tip plane the thrust on the heel line is extended to the key bottom (foundation K_a, δ = β; surcharge, water and seismic increments and the inertia of the soil beside the key included). The smaller ratio governs. With an undrained foundation, seismic loading or sloping backfill, the key-zone thrust cannot be computed; the analysis stops with an explicit error
report.assumption.wall.shear_key_demands: Key depth is not added to the bearing embedment (conservative in every case); only shear and moment demands are given for the key (V = unreduced static passive, M = V·arm); no reinforced-concrete design
report.assumption.wall.shear_key_global: Global stability is computed without the key: the Bishop circle passes below the base and the key volume is treated as soil. The strength side is conservative (concrete is stronger than soil); the neglected concrete-soil weight difference has a small effect
report.struct.design_code: Structure design code (used in this calculation)
report.assumption.wall.gwt_static_case: Static groundwater scenario {case}; retained-side depth {retained} m, front-side depth {front} m
report.assumption.wall.base_level: The base lies at depth H below the retained ground surface; the front ground is at level H-D; the overburden removed by front excavation is not taken into account
report.assumption.wall.layered_coulomb: Layers are horizontal; each layer's Coulomb coefficient is applied to the vertical stress of all layers above; this is not a layered critical-wedge solution
report.assumption.wall.undrained_pressur: The c' contribution is neglected in Coulomb drained thrust; for undrained horizontal soil total stress and s_u are used and horizontal water is not added a second time
report.assumption.wall.heel_soil_polygon: The soil above the heel is split into polygons at layer and water levels; total γ_sat weight is used below water and uplift is applied separately at the base
report.assumption.wall.hydrostatic_model: Retained/front water levels are the structure's groundwater values (the profile groundwater if none); hydrostatic horizontal pressure and linear uplift between front/back base pressures; no seepage analysis
report.assumption.wall.bearing_base_laye: Bearing capacity uses the base layer only; a weaker layer within B is flagged; two-layer bearing capacity and settlement are not computed
report.assumption.wall.delta_base_defaul: If the base delta_base is not given, the FoundationSoil default delta_base=phi is used; adhesion is taken as 0
report.assumption.wall.bearing_method: Bearing capacity method: {method}; includes load inclination and B'=B-2|e|; base/front ground slope factors are 1
report.assumption.wall.uplift_moment_ove: The uplift moment is added to the overturning demand: FS_ot=M_R/(M_O+M_U)
report.assumption.wall.uplift_moment_res: The uplift moment is deducted from the resistance: FS_ot=(M_R−M_U)/M_O
report.assumption.wall.gwt_bearing_corre: Drained N_gamma groundwater correction is on: d_w is the depth of the front water below the base; γ' for d_w≤0, γ'+(d_w/B)(γ−γ') for 0<d_w<B, γ for d_w≥B
The drained N_gamma groundwater transition correction is switched off by user choice; γ' is used for water at or above the base and γ below the base
report.assumption.wall.embedment_search: Embedment D = {D} m; the size search uses 0.05 m steps up to B ≤ 1.2H
report.assumption.wall.section_proportio: Section proportions in sizing are taken from the existing proportion_for function
report.assumption.wall.load_factors: Loads are not factored in the ASD global-FS case; with partial factors WA is a separate user input and is not derived from the G/EH factor; material.gamma is not applied and DC/EV load factors are used
report.assumption.wall.virtual_plane_can: Vertical virtual plane through the heel tip: H_v=H+heel·tanβ; the additional upper part is the topmost layer; δ=β
report.assumption.wall.real_back_face_gr: Thrust acts on the real inclined back face; θ=atan(back batter/H), δ=2φ'/3 per layer
report.assumption.wall.passive_on: Passive resistance is on; user/setting reduction {reduction}; it contributes to sliding only and horizontal water is not reduced
report.assumption.wall.passive_off: Passive resistance was not taken into account
report.assumption.wall.passive_reduction: Passive reduction factor = {reduction} — engineer's choice (no published source given)
report.assumption.wall.toe_soil_included: The natural soil weight above the toe is included
report.assumption.wall.toe_soil_ignored: The natural soil weight above the toe is neglected
report.assumption.wall.surcharge_resists: The vertical surcharge load above the heel is counted as stabilising
report.assumption.wall.surcharge_not_res: The vertical surcharge load above the heel is not counted as stabilising
report.assumption.wall.basic_level: Basic level: ASD, Vesic, passive and toe soil are off; base friction from the approved layer value (tanδ=min(tanφ,0.6) in the BASIC transfer)
report.assumption.wall.gwt_seismic_case: Seismic groundwater scenario; retained-side depth {retained} m, front-side depth {front} m
report.assumption.wall.seismic_kh_kv: k_h=0.4·S_DS/r, |k_v|=0.5·k_h, r={r}; dynamic thrust increment acts at H_v/2
report.assumption.wall.seismic_scope: M-O is applied per layer; static water is hydrostatic; liquefaction and excess pore pressure are not computed; undrained seismic thrust stops the analysis; TBDY Eq. 16.24b is used for β > φ' − ψ
report.assumption.wall.submerged_seismic: Submerged seismic option: {mode}; γ*=γ_sat−γ_w; impervious tanψ=γ_sat/γ*·kh/(1−kv), pervious tanψ=γ/γ*·kh/(1−kv) (γ natural unit weight); dynamic water kh=0.4·S_DS (r=1). The base lies below the virtual back plane; partial submergence is a per-layer engineering judgement; for mixed permeability the full water height is used once if any layer is pervious (unverified engineering approximation); external free water is not modelled. The governing option is in the case warnings; the force and position of the dynamic water are in forces.
report.assumption.wall.global_model: Bishop circles pass below the base; the carried weight is spread as an equivalent load on the base footprint; for the slip model the higher of the front/back groundwater is used as a single horizontal water level; slices are horizontal and the lowest slice is infinite; the thin strip above the base on the front side is represented with the retained-side slices; k_v is not applied in the global slices
report.assumption.wall.global_partial_fa: In partial-factor global stability the surcharge is multiplied by γ_Q (LS) and the concrete/carried-soil loads on the base footprint by the unfavourable γ_G (DC/EV). Slice soil self-weight stays characteristic (1.0 for DA1-C2/DA3); no factoring of soil self-weight is applied for DA1-C1/DA2
report.assumption.wall.global_off: The global-stability check is switched off by user input
